verdict.rationale: MX publishes an official OpenAPI specification (mx-gh-1) and supports importing it into Postman for API exploration (mx-docs-12/26), which enables building typed/generated clients, but there is no evidence of dedicated first-party SDK libraries (e.g., Python, JS, Java) or SDK-specific documentation/examples. missing for 10: named official SDK packages/libraries, language-specific SDK docs, and independent confirmation of SDK usage.
